text:
Rickard Rakell is the Penguin everyone is shopping for. Pittsburgh has lost nine of his last ten games, and ClutchPoints and The Hockey News both reported last week that he blocked a trade to Chicago. Sportsnet's Elliotte Friedman then linked the Senators to him and Bryan Rust, with Ottawa's general manager watching in Nashville, according to Coming Down the Pipe's Graeme Nichols.

His game is simple and it travels: shots, lots of them. He has 63 shots and 9.5 expected goals in 23 games, eight goals, and our projection has him finishing somewhere between 24 and 40 goals. His goals have mattered, too, 39th of 560 skaters in our wins-added measure. The assists are the thin part, five all season, and his overall scoring rate sits below the league's 2.1 per 60.

Evolving-Hockey had his competition in the 97th percentile last season, and Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking found nothing unusual in his style, no clear strength or weakness. That's a shooter, not a play driver. Watch where he plays in a month; it may not be Pittsburgh.
